dedupe_keys.name: european industrial emissions portal and industrial reporting dataset ied and e prtr

description: The European Industrial Emissions Portal is the European Environment Agency's single entry point for data on the impacts of industrial activities in Europe; it replaced the E-PRTR website in 2021. It covers over 60,000 industrial sites in 65 economic activities: energy, metal production and processing, minerals, chemicals, waste and waste water management, paper and wood, intensive livestock and aquaculture, food and beverage, and others. For each site it gives location and administrative data, releases and transfers of regulated substances to air, water and land, and waste transfers, with more detailed energy input and emissions for large combustion plants, all reported annually under the Industrial Emissions Directive (2010/75/EU), the EU Registry on Industrial Sites and the E-PRTR Regulation (166/2006). Data are free to browse on a site map and analysis pages, and the full Industrial Reporting dataset (catalogue record revised 20 February 2026, reporting years from 2007) can be downloaded from the EEA spatial data catalogue, together with the EU air pollutant and greenhouse gas inventories and the EU ETS dataset. The catalogue record lists no licence text. Caveats: only installations above the reporting thresholds are included, and national reporting quality differs. For simulation it provides an asset inventory of industrial facilities with their emissions for hazard exposure, natech and environmental impact studies. Related catalogue records include the EPA Facility Registry Service and Toxics Release Inventory for the United States.
